caseName: Real Estate - Land Title & Trust Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Real Estate - Land Title & Trust Co. v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Maurice Bower Saul for petitioner. Solicitor General Jackson and Messrs. Sewall Key, J. Louis Monarch, and Arnold Raum for the United States.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit granted.

Mr. Justice Roberts and Mr. Justice Reed took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
